notes: Image backgrounds can now be repositioned too. The Scale / X / Y framing controls — previously only on video backgrounds — now show for image backgrounds as well, so you can pan and zoom an image to focus the part you want instead of being stuck with a centre crop. The render already supported this (v1.5.5); this exposes the sliders in the editor. Uploaded videos keep the same framing controls (and an old in-place-swap bug that ignored the new pan model is fixed). Video-only options (Fit, Speed, Clip, Audio) stay hidden for images.
